description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for date strings following a specific format ('Y-m-d') within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It extends an abstract validation rule and uses a trait for date-time validation helpers.

classes.name: ApiDate
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input string matches the date format 'Y-m-d'. It extends AbstractRule and uses CanValidateDateTime trait for helper methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided input is a scalar and if it matches the 'Y-m-d' date format.
